docs.title: Position sizing
docs.body: Risk budget = account equity × risk percentage. Position size = risk budget ÷ absolute distance between entry and stop. Account for contract value and transaction costs. This educational example does not recommend a trade.

docs.title: Reading market structure
docs.body: Identify swing highs and lows, distinguish trend from range, and define the condition that invalidates a hypothesis. A chart pattern is not a guarantee of future performance.

docs.title: Trading journal review
docs.body: Record entry rationale, planned risk, execution, emotions and outcome. Review a series of observations rather than drawing conclusions from one trade.

docs.body: Demo policy: respect fellow learners, protect private information, label simulated analysis and do not solicit funds. This sample policy is not an approved client policy.
